main_text.l: strina Evangelii, fides & confessio ponuntur pro
Christo, & ab hoc denominantur Petra: neque enim

Christo, fides in Christum & confessio Christi; ita
verò Persona Petri nullâ ratione refolvi potest, id est,
Petrus pro Christo supponi nequit.

1. Non ratione personae suae; sed vel ratione of-
ficii sui, & quidem tantùm quatenus supra
Christum aedificabat: vel ratione qualita-
tis, non propriae, sed communicatae à Chri-
sto & in Christo, Petra dici potuit.
2. Non solus Petra est; sed & omnes Apostoli
& horum in aedificanda Ecclesia successores:
omnes item fide in Christo superstructi &

page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment ("strina"), the rest of "doctrina", and it is kept as printed. The "γ." and "3." before the list items are printed numbering marks. The text is set in the same type throughout. Show-through from the reverse side appears faintly in both margins and was left out.
